description: This file defines a class Kint_Parsers_Xml that extends a parser class for handling XML data. It contains a method to parse XML strings and set the internal value accordingly.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_Xml
classes.description: A parser class for handling XML data within the Kint debugging tool's parser ecosystem.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses an XML string if it starts with '<?xml', sets the parsed XML object or returns false if invalid.
